benefit: Borage (Borago officinalis) attracts honeybees and bumble bees that improve strawberry pollination and fruit set. Field reports also cite improved fruit flavor and reduced hornworm pressure on adjacent solanaceae.

members.title: Borage at strawberry block edges
members.body: Direct-sow borage at the corners and edges of the strawberry planting after final frost. One plant per 25 to 50 sq ft of bed.
